prompt: Create a high-fidelity 16:10 desktop web application UI composition for CODEQUEST, a System 404 coding-learning platform. Keep the committed Repair Field Manual visual world: warm uncoated manual paper, blueprint navy ink, repair orange stamps, technical service-manual typography, tabbed chapters, numbered procedures, thin diagnostic rules, square controls. Composition variation B: a narrow vertical chapter-index rail on the left, a slim utility/status strip across the top, and one wide central procedure workspace. The procedure header says CURRENT PROCEDURE / CONTINUE MISSION and owns the primary orange action. Below it, use a two-thirds step sequence and one-third outer diagnostic margin with course progress, assessment readiness, teacher needs-attention evidence, and admin system status, proving this system carries all three roles. Real interface content, dense but readable. No gradients, rounded SaaS cards, glassmorphism, neon cyberpunk, fake logo, portraits, or illustrations. Straight-on full browser screenshot, production-grade and legible.
